sourceTitle: A guide to fostering, April 2026 (Fostering North Yorkshire, North Yorkshire Council)
feesNote: Every carer, including those not yet accredited, receives the weekly rate for the child's age; accredited carers also receive an age-related fee on top, which the council's guide shows rounded to the nearest pound. Advanced and specialist carers are paid further skills fees, which the guide lists under a 2025-26 heading, so they are not shown here.
extras: Birthday, Christmas and two weeks' holiday allowances, shown in the council's guide as four weeks of the child's weekly rate a year
Short break care paid per period of up to 24 hours, at three levels
Day care at £10.17 an hour from April 2026
summary: North Yorkshire pays every foster carer a weekly rate for each child in four age bands; these 2026-27 figures follow the council's decision of 3 March 2026 to raise foster carer payments by 3.4%. Once accredited, carers also receive a weekly age-related fee on top, and advanced and specialist carers are paid additional skills fees.
